description.zh:
根据输入值对实例的加速类型进行筛选。默认为空，此时查询所有加速类型的实例。可取值如下：
- CPU：无计算加速，只使用CPU计算。
- GPU：使用GPU进行计算加速。
description.en:
Filters instances by accelerator type. Default value: empty. If this parameter is left empty, instances of all accelerator types are returned. Valid values:
- CPU: No compute acceleration. Only CPU is used for computation.
- GPU: GPU is used for compute acceleration.

description.zh:
根据输入值对实例的工作空间可见性进行筛选。默认为空，此时查询所有可见性的实例。可取值如下：
- PRIVATE（默认值）：表示工作空间内自己以及管理员可见。
- PUBLIC：为工作空间所有用户可见。
description.en:
Filters instances by workspace visibility. Default value: empty. If this parameter is left empty, instances of all visibility types are returned. Valid values:
- PRIVATE (default): The instance is visible only to the creator and workspace administrators.
- PUBLIC: The instance is visible to all users in the workspace.

description.zh: 如果填写，则筛选出创建时间晚于（或等于）该时间的实例。
description.en: If specified, only instances created at or after this time are returned.

description.zh: 如果填写，筛选出创建时间早于（或等于）该时间的实例。
description.en: If specified, only instances created at or before this time are returned.

description.zh: 如果填写该项，则根据输入值对实例的创建者UserId进行筛选。
description.en: Filters instances by the user ID of the creator.

description.zh: 如果填写该项，则根据输入值对实例的GPU 型号进行筛选。
description.en: Filters instances by GPU model.

description.zh: 镜像名。如果填写该项，则根据输入值对实例使用的镜像名称进行筛选。
description.en: The image name. If specified, instances are filtered by the name of the image used.

description.zh: 如果填写该项，则按实例ID进行精确筛选。如何获取实例ID，请参见[ListInstances](~~470439~~)。支持以逗号分隔的方式传入多个ID实现多选。
description.en: Filters instances by instance ID using exact match. For information about how to obtain the instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~470439~~). You can specify multiple IDs separated by commas.

description.zh: 实例名称。如果填写，则根据输入值对实例名称进行搜索。搜索行为是模糊匹配+大小写不敏感。默认为空。
description.en: The instance name. If specified, instances are searched by name using fuzzy match and case-insensitive comparison. Default value: empty.

description.zh: 如果填写该项，则根据输入值按照实例的标签进行筛选，最多支持4组标签，多组标签之间以AND条件进行组合筛选。
description.en: Filters instances by labels. A maximum of four label groups are supported. Multiple label groups are combined using AND conditions.

description.zh: 最大的CPU数量，单位是0.001 CPU，1000表示1个CPU。如果填写该项，则筛选出CPU数量小于输入值的实例。
description.en: The maximum number of CPUs, in units of 0.001 CPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 CPU. If specified, only instances with a CPU count less than this value are returned.

description.zh: 最大的GPU数量，单位是0.001 GPU，1000表示1个GPU。如果填写该项，则筛选出GPU数量小于输入值的实例。
description.en: The maximum number of GPUs, in units of 0.001 GPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 GPU. If specified, only instances with a GPU count less than this value are returned.

description.zh: 最大单卡 GPU 显存大小，单位是 G。如果填写该项，则筛选出 GPU 显存小于输入值的实例。
description.en: The maximum GPU memory per card in GB. If specified, only instances with GPU memory less than this value are returned.

description.zh: 最大的机器内存数，单位是G。如果填写该项，则筛选出内存小于输入值的实例。
description.en: The maximum memory size in GB. If specified, only instances with memory less than this value are returned.

description.zh: 最小的CPU数量，单位是0.001 CPU，1000表示1个CPU。如果填写该项，则筛选出CPU数量大于输入值的实例。
description.en: The minimum number of CPUs, in units of 0.001 CPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 CPU. If specified, only instances with a CPU count greater than this value are returned.

description.zh: 最小的GPU数量，单位是0.001 GPU，1000表示1个GPU。如果填写该项，则筛选出GPU数量大于输入值的实例。
description.en: The minimum number of GPUs, in units of 0.001 GPU. A value of 1000 indicates 1 GPU. If specified, only instances with a GPU count greater than this value are returned.

description.zh: 最小单卡GPU显存大小，单位是G。如果填写该项，则筛选出GPU显存大于输入值的实例。
description.en: The minimum GPU memory per card in GB. If specified, only instances with GPU memory greater than this value are returned.

description.zh: 最小的机器内存数，单位是G。如果填写该项，则筛选出内存大于输入值的实例。
description.en: The minimum memory size in GB. If specified, only instances with memory greater than this value are returned.

description.zh: 排列顺序。可取值DESC或ASC，默认为DESC。
description.en: The sort order. Valid values: DESC and ASC. Default value: DESC.

description.zh:
实例实际使用的闲时资源类型。如果填写该项，则根据输入值对实例实际使用的闲时资源类型进行筛选。支持的值：
+ ForbiddenQuotaOverSold：使用保障资源
+ ForceQuotaOverSold：使用闲时资源
+ PendingQuotaOverSold：待分配
description.en:
The idle resource type actually used by the instance. If specified, instances are filtered by the idle resource type actually in use. Valid values:
+ ForbiddenQuotaOverSold: uses guaranteed resources.
+ ForceQuotaOverSold: uses idle resources.
+ PendingQuotaOverSold: pending allocation.

description.zh:
用户指定的闲时资源类型。如果填写，则根据输入值对实例的闲时资源类型进行筛选。支持的值：
+ ForceQuotaOverSold：只使用闲时资源
+ AcceptQuotaOverSold：可接受闲时资源
+ ForbiddenQuotaOverSold：使用保障资源
description.en:
The user-specified idle resource type. If specified, instances are filtered by the idle resource type. Valid values:
+ ForceQuotaOverSold: uses only idle resources.
+ AcceptQuotaOverSold: accepts idle resources.
+ ForbiddenQuotaOverSold: uses guaranteed resources.

description.zh: 实例分页查询的页码。起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number for paging query of instances. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页查询每页返回的实例数量，默认为10。
description.en: The number of instances returned per page in a paging query. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 根据输入值对实例的付费类型（预付费或后付费）进行筛选。默认为空，此时查询所有付费类型的实例。
description.en: Filters instances by payment type (subscription or pay-as-you-go). Default value: empty. If this parameter is left empty, instances of all payment types are returned.

description.zh:
按资源配额的ID进行筛选，如何获取资源配额ID请参见[ListQuotas](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/developer-reference/api-aiworkspace-2021-02-04-listquotas)。
默认值为空，此时只返回后付费资源组的实例。
填 ALL 会返回所有的实例。
description.en:
Filters instances by resource quota ID. For information about how to obtain the resource quota ID, see [ListQuotas](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pai/developer-reference/api-aiworkspace-2021-02-04-listquotas).
Default value: empty. If this parameter is left empty, only instances in pay-as-you-go resource groups are returned.
Set this parameter to ALL to return all instances.

description.zh: 排序字段。
description.en: The field by which to sort the results.

description.zh: 根据输入值对实例状态进行筛选。默认为空，此时查询所有状态的实例。
description.en: Filters instances by instance status. Default value: empty. If this parameter is left empty, instances in all statuses are returned.

description.zh: 标签列表。如果填写该项，则根据输入值按照实例的标签进行筛选，最多支持 4 组标签，多组标签之间以 AND 条件进行组合筛选。
description.en: The list of tags. If specified, instances are filtered by tags. A maximum of four tag groups are supported. Multiple tag groups are combined using AND conditions.

description.zh: 标签Key。
description.en: The tag key.

description.zh: 标签的值。
description.en: The tag value.

description.zh: 按工作空间ID筛选。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见[ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~)。默认值为空，此时会使用当前子账号的“默认工作空间”，如何查看默认工作空间，请参见[GetDefaultWorkspace](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/developer-reference/api-aiworkspace-2021-02-04-getdefaultworkspace?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-30347.d_5_0_1_4_2_5.6e1f4c800OFLec)。如果需要查询所有工作空间的实例，请填写ALL。
description.en: Filters instances by workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~). Default value: empty. If this parameter is left empty, the default workspace of the current RAM user is used. For information about how to view the default workspace, see [GetDefaultWorkspace](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pai/developer-reference/api-aiworkspace-2021-02-04-getdefaultworkspace). To query instances across all workspaces, set this parameter to ALL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dsw list-instances --workspace-id 40823 --instance-name training_data --resource-id ALL --status Running --payment-type PayAsYouGo --accessibility PRIVATE --accelerator-type CPU --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order DESC --instance-id dsw-730xxxxxxxxxx --labels key1=value1 key2=value2 key3=value3 --create-user-id 123450000067890 --gpu-type NVIDIA_A10 --min-cpu 2000 --max-cpu 30000 --min-gpu 100 --max-gpu 8000 --min-memory 4 --max-memory 48 --min-gpu-memory 8 --max-gpu-memory 16 --image-name modelscope:1.9.4-pytorch2.0.1tensorflow2.13.0-cpu-py38-ubuntu20.04 --tag Value=value1 Key=tag1 --oversold-info ForceQuotaOverSold --oversold-type AcceptQuotaOverSold --create-time-after 2024-01-12T14:36:01Z --create-time-before 2024-01-12T15:36:01Z --api-version 2022-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
